title: AND value when the other coordinates are negative
statement: Let $w,s$ be nonnegative integers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{sw}$, and choose a coordinate $i$ of this vector, corresponding to block $j$ and within-block coordinate $o$. If every other coordinate of block $j$ equals $-1$, then the AND of block $j$ equals $x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate of a vector of length $sw$
Every within-block coordinate other than the one corresponding to $i$ has value $-1$
